records.name: Kuku Flame Spear
records.summary: A two-handed spear crafted at the Kilnden Workshop, with a fire burst on every swing and no durability.
records.body: The Kilnden Workshop and every named Kuku piece rest on one KeenGamer article. The spear is said to explode fire around nearby enemies on each swing and to have no durability. Like other gear, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: Crafted by Grimnir at the Kilnden Workshop after Chapter 4. No recipe record exists here yet.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and open the Kilnden Workshop.
Speak with Grimnir at the bench.
Craft Kuku Flame Spear from the workshop blueprint.
